extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Dare to enter Duskmourn, a plane-enveloping House that sets the scene for your opponent’s greatest fears to come to life!
Great for Limited play and fun to open, each Bundle contains 9 Play Boosters, with a possibility of multiple Rares and at least 1 shining foil card in every pack. Every Bundle also comes with 1 Traditional Foil promo card featuring Bundle-exclusive alternate art, and 10 of the 30 included Land cards feature spine-tingling Full Art.

Each Duskmourn: House of Horror - Bundle contains the following:
• 9 Duskmourn: House of Horror - Play Booster Packs
• 1 Traditional Foil alt-art card
• 30 Land cards (15 foil, 15 non-foil)
• 1 Spindown life counter
• 1 card storage box
• 2 reference cards

Each Duskmourn: House of Horror - Bundle Case includes 6 bundles.
